global_rules: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts. Shadcn UI for interactive elements (Forms, Inputs, Buttons).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not use generic font like Inter for headings. Ensure 'Outfit' is loaded from Google Fonts.
Ensure generous padding for sections (py-24) to let the content breathe.
Button hover effects should be distinct and provide good contrast.
